GUEST REVIEW — posted July 13 by Yuki T.
Rating: 4 out of 5 stars
The view of the bay from our room on the ninth floor was stunning, and the staff honored every benefit promised when I booked. questions.explanation: 공고문에서 학생 15명 이상의 학교 단체는 학생당 $8의 특별 요금이 적용된다고 했고, 예약 양식에 학생 수가 30명으로 기재되어 있어 조건을 충족합니다. 공고문과 예약 양식을 연계해야 하는 문제입니다.

questions.question: What is suggested about the school's booking?
options: It was submitted past the museum's deadline.
It was made more than two weeks before the visit.
It had to be moved because of a Monday closure.
It was paid for by credit card.
questions.explanation: 공고문에서 단체 방문은 최소 2주 전에 예약해야 한다고 했습니다. 양식 제출일은 10월 14일이고 방문일은 11월 4일로 3주 정도 전이므로 기한을 충족합니다. 공고문과 양식의 날짜를 결합하는 연계 문제입니다.

questions.question: Is Ms. Rahman's understanding about the chaperone tickets correct?
options: Yes — three chaperones enter free and one pays.
No — only two chaperone tickets are free.
No — all four chaperones must pay the adult rate.
No — every chaperone enters free with a school group.
questions.explanation: 공고문에서 학생 10명당 보호자 1명이 무료라고 했습니다. 학생이 30명이므로 무료 보호자 티켓은 3장이고, 보호자가 4명으로 줄었으니 1명만 성인 요금을 내면 됩니다. 따라서 이메일 속 그녀의 계산은 정확합니다. 공고문, 양식, 이메일을 모두 연계해야 하는 문제입니다.

questions.question: What does Ms. Rahman ask about the café?
options: Whether it offers a group discount
Whether it can seat 34 people at once
Whether ingredient information is displayed
Whether it opens before 10:00 A.M.
questions.explanation: 이메일에서 두 학생에게 음식 알레르기가 있다며 'could you confirm that ingredient information is posted in the café?'라고 물었습니다. 즉 카페에 성분 정보가 게시되어 있는지 확인을 요청한 것입니다.

passage:
ADVERTISEMENT — PaperTrail Office Supplies: Smart Restock Subscription
Never run out of supplies again! Subscribe to monthly deliveries and save 12% on every order. Subscribers may skip a month or modify their box up to three business days before the scheduled shipping date. Free delivery on all subscription orders. New subscribers receive a welcome kit with product samples in their first box.

--- Passage 2 ---
ACCOUNT STATEMENT — PaperTrail Office Supplies
Subscriber: Lindqvist & Associates (account manager: Erik Lindqvist)
May shipment (shipped May 6): copy paper x 10 reams, toner cartridge x 2, sticky notes x 12 — $151.36 after 12% discount
June shipment (scheduled to ship June 8): copy paper x 10 reams, toner cartridge x 2, sticky notes x 12 — estimated $151.36
Modification deadline for June box: June 3

--- Passage 3 ---
To: service@papertrailsupplies.com
From: erik@lindqvistassociates.com
Date: June 5
Subject: June box — change request

Hello,
Our firm is moving offices in mid-June, and we still have unopened supplies from May. I tried to remove the toner cartridges from our June box this morning, but the Web site says the order is locked. I realize I may have missed a cutoff, but given that we have been subscribers for two years, I hope an exception can be made. If not, please skip our July box entirely — I will make that change today, well before any deadline. Could you also update our delivery address effective July 1? I will send the new address separately.
Thank you, Erik Lindqvist

questions.question: According to the advertisement, what do new subscribers receive?
options: A 20% discount on their first order
A kit containing product samples
A free toner cartridge
A dedicated account manager
questions.explanation: 광고에서 'New subscribers receive a welcome kit with product samples in their first box'라고 했으므로 제품 샘플이 담긴 웰컴 키트가 정답입니다.

questions.question: Why was Mr. Lindqvist unable to modify the June box?
options: His subscription had been suspended.
He attempted the change after the modification deadline.
The items were already out of stock.
Only the account manager may change orders.
questions.explanation: 명세서에서 6월 박스의 수정 마감일은 6월 3일인데, 이메일을 보면 그가 변경을 시도한 날은 6월 5일입니다. 마감일이 지나 주문이 잠긴 것입니다. 명세서와 이메일의 날짜를 연계해야 하는 문제입니다.

questions.question: What does Mr. Lindqvist plan to do about the July shipment?
options: Double the quantity of copy paper
Have it delivered to a temporary address
Skip it entirely
Cancel the subscription
questions.explanation: 이메일에서 'please skip our July box entirely — I will make that change today'라고 했으므로 7월 박스는 완전히 건너뛸 계획입니다. 광고에서 구독자는 한 달을 건너뛸 수 있다고 했으므로 가능한 조치입니다.

questions.question: How much did Lindqvist & Associates save on the May shipment?
options: About $12.00
About $18.00
About $20.64
About $151.36
questions.explanation: 5월 결제액 $151.36은 12% 할인이 적용된 금액입니다. 원래 금액은 $151.36 ÷ 0.88 = $172.00이므로 절약액은 약 $20.64입니다. 광고의 할인율과 명세서의 금액을 결합해야 하는 연계 계산 문제입니다.

questions.question: What additional request does Mr. Lindqvist make?
options: A refund for unused toner
A change to the firm's delivery address
An extension of his subscription discount
A copy of his two-year order history
questions.explanation: 이메일 마지막에 'Could you also update our delivery address effective July 1?'라고 했습니다. 사무실 이전에 따라 7월 1일부로 배송지 변경을 요청한 것입니다.

passage:
COURSE CATALOG — Stratus Professional Training (Quarter 3)
PM-201 Project Management Fundamentals — online, self-paced, $240
CM-115 Effective Client Communication — in person, July 21–22, $380
DA-310 Data Analysis with Spreadsheets — online, live sessions Wednesdays in August, $310
Companies enrolling three or more employees in the same course receive 15% off each seat. Certificates are issued upon completion.

--- Passage 2 ---
To: training@stratuspro.com
From: yfujimoto@calderagroup.com
Date: July 1
Subject: Enrollment — Caldera Group

Hello,
I would like to enroll four employees from our client services team in CM-115 on July 21–22: myself, Brian Okafor, Susan Reyes, and Mei Lin. I understand we qualify for your multi-seat discount. Please invoice our accounts department. Separately, I would like to enroll just myself in DA-310 in August — I assume the discount does not apply to a single seat.
Regards, Yuna Fujimoto, Client Services Manager

--- Passage 3 ---
MEMO — Caldera Group Human Resources
Date: July 3 | To: Department Managers | From: HR Director
Re: Training reimbursements

Effective this quarter, the company will fully reimburse approved external training that is completed with a certificate. Courses paid by departmental budgets must be approved in advance for amounts over $1,000 per invoice. Managers should submit certificates to HR within 30 days of course completion. Note that online self-paced courses are reimbursed at 50% only, as they do not include live instruction.

questions.question: What is true about course DA-310?
options: It is held in person over two days.
It includes live online sessions.
It is the least expensive course listed.
It does not award a certificate.
questions.explanation: 카탈로그에서 DA-310은 'online, live sessions Wednesdays in August'로 매주 수요일 실시간 온라인 수업입니다. 가격은 $310으로 최저가($240)가 아니며, 수료증은 모든 과정에서 발급됩니다.

questions.question: How much will Caldera Group be invoiced for the CM-115 enrollment?
questions.explanation: CM-115는 1인당 $380이고 4명을 등록하므로 정가는 $1,520입니다. 같은 과정에 3명 이상 등록 시 좌석당 15% 할인되므로 $1,520 × 0.85 = $1,292입니다. 카탈로그의 가격·할인 조건과 이메일의 인원을 결합해야 하는 연계 계산 문제입니다.

questions.question: Is Ms. Fujimoto's assumption about her DA-310 enrollment correct?
options: Yes — the discount requires at least three seats in the same course.
No — managers always receive the discount.
No — the discount applies to any online course.
Yes — discounts apply only to in-person courses.
questions.explanation: 카탈로그에서 할인은 '같은 과정에 3명 이상 등록하는 회사'에 적용됩니다. DA-310에는 본인 1명만 등록하므로 할인이 없다는 그녀의 추정은 옳습니다. 이메일과 카탈로그를 연계하는 문제입니다.

questions.question: According to the memo, why might the CM-115 invoice need advance approval?
options: It covers a course held outside the country.
It exceeds $1,000.
It includes a nonrefundable deposit.
It was submitted after the quarter began.
questions.explanation: 메모에서 부서 예산으로 결제하는 과정은 청구서당 $1,000를 초과하면 사전 승인이 필요하다고 했습니다. CM-115의 청구액은 할인 후에도 $1,292로 $1,000를 넘으므로 사전 승인 대상입니다. 메모와 계산 결과를 연계해야 하는 문제입니다.

questions.question: Which course would be reimbursed at only 50% under the new policy?
options: All three courses
questions.explanation: 메모에서 실시간 강의가 없는 온라인 자율 학습(self-paced) 과정은 50%만 환급한다고 했습니다. 카탈로그에서 self-paced 과정은 PM-201뿐입니다. CM-115는 대면, DA-310은 실시간 온라인이므로 전액 환급 대상입니다. 메모와 카탈로그를 연계하는 문제입니다.

passage:
WEBPAGE — Roadrunner Car Rentals: Weekend Saver
Rent any compact or midsize car from Friday noon to Monday 10:00 A.M. for a flat $89. Offer includes 300 free kilometers; each additional kilometer is $0.25. Renters must refuel before returning the vehicle or pay a $40 refueling service charge. A second driver can be added for $10 per weekend. Offer valid at airport and downtown locations.

--- Passage 2 ---
RENTAL AGREEMENT — Roadrunner Car Rentals (Downtown Branch)
Agreement #RR-6643 | Renter: Carlos Mendes | Additional driver: Inez Mendes ($10)
Vehicle: midsize sedan | Pickup: Friday, August 8, 12:30 P.M.
Return due: Monday, August 11, 10:00 A.M. | Rate: Weekend Saver $89
Odometer at pickup: 41,250 km | Fuel level at pickup: Full

--- Passage 3 ---
To: customercare@roadrunnerrentals.com
From: cmendes@oltremail.com
Date: August 13
Subject: Disputed charge — Agreement #RR-6643

Dear Customer Care,
My invoice shows a total of $151.50, which is higher than I expected. The odometer read 41,560 km when I returned the car, so I accept the charge for the kilometers beyond the included allowance. However, I was also billed the $40 refueling charge even though I filled the tank at the station two blocks from your downtown branch and have the receipt, stamped Monday 9:12 A.M. Please remove that charge. The remaining items — the weekend rate and the second-driver fee — are correct.
Sincerely, Carlos Mendes

questions.question: According to the Web page, what happens if a car is returned without a full tank?
options: The rental rate is doubled.
A $40 service charge is applied.
The renter loses the free-kilometer allowance.
The deposit is forfeited.
questions.explanation: 웹페이지에 'refuel before returning the vehicle or pay a $40 refueling service charge'라고 명시되어 있으므로 $40의 주유 대행 수수료가 부과됩니다.

questions.question: How many kilometers did Mr. Mendes drive during the rental?
options: 250 km
300 km
310 km
410 km
questions.explanation: 계약서의 픽업 시 주행계는 41,250km이고 이메일에서 반납 시 41,560km라고 했으므로 주행 거리는 310km입니다. 계약서와 이메일을 연계해야 하는 계산 문제입니다.

questions.question: How much was Mr. Mendes charged for extra kilometers?
questions.explanation: 무료 제공 거리는 300km이고 실제 주행은 310km이므로 초과분은 10km입니다. 초과 1km당 $0.25이므로 10 × $0.25 = $2.50입니다. 웹페이지의 요금 조건과 두 지문의 주행계 수치를 모두 결합해야 하는 삼중 연계 문제입니다. 실제로 $89 + $10 + $2.50 + $40(분쟁 항목) = $151.50으로 청구서와 일치합니다.

questions.question: Why does Mr. Mendes believe the refueling charge is incorrect?
options: The car had a full tank at pickup.
He has a receipt proving he refueled before returning the car.
The charge exceeds the amount stated online.
Refueling charges do not apply at downtown locations.
questions.explanation: 이메일에서 반납 전 지점 근처 주유소에서 주유했고 월요일 오전 9시 12분 도장이 찍힌 영수증이 있다고 했습니다. 반납 기한(오전 10시) 전에 주유를 마쳤음을 입증할 수 있으므로 $40 수수료가 부당하다는 것입니다.

questions.question: Which charge on the invoice does Mr. Mendes accept as valid besides the weekend rate?
options: The refueling service charge
The additional-driver fee
An airport surcharge
A late-return penalty
questions.explanation: 이메일에서 'the weekend rate and the second-driver fee — are correct'라고 했습니다. 계약서에도 추가 운전자 Inez Mendes에 대한 $10 요금이 기재되어 있습니다. 그가 이의를 제기한 것은 주유 수수료뿐입니다.

passage:

Subject: Thank you, Rosa!

Dear Rosa,

questions.question: According to the notice, what must volunteers do to earn the season rewards?
options: Attend the cast dinner in December
Work at least eight performances in a season
Volunteer on both Friday and Saturday each week
Recruit one additional volunteer
questions.explanation: 공지문에서 'Volunteers who work at least eight performances per season receive two free tickets... and an invitation to the cast appreciation dinner'라고 했으므로 한 시즌에 8회 이상 근무하는 것이 보상 조건입니다.

questions.question: Why did Ms. Jimenez qualify for the rewards?
options: She worked nine performances, exceeding the minimum.
She volunteered every weekend of the season.
She completed an advanced training course.
She worked more hours than any other volunteer.
questions.explanation: 공지문의 기준은 8회 이상인데, 봉사 기록표에 총 9회 근무로 기재되어 있어 기준을 초과 달성했습니다. 공지문과 기록표를 연계해야 하는 문제입니다.

questions.question: What event does the e-mail most likely refer to when praising Ms. Jimenez's reliability?
options: The September 6 training session
The opening performance on September 12
The November 14 performance
The final performance on November 22
questions.explanation: 이메일의 'the evening you managed the ticket line single-handedly'는 기록표의 'Covered ticket scanning alone on Nov 14 when a second usher canceled'와 일치합니다. 기록표와 이메일을 연계해 날짜를 특정해야 하는 문제입니다.

questions.question: By when should Ms. Jimenez respond about the dinner?
options: By December 1
By December 8
By December 12
By January 5
questions.explanation: 이메일에서 'please reply by December 8 if you can attend'라고 했으므로 12월 8일까지 참석 여부를 회신해야 합니다. 12월 12일은 만찬 당일, 1월 5일은 무료 티켓 예약 시작일입니다.

questions.question: What is suggested about the complimentary tickets?
options: They must be used before December 12.
They are valid for the winter season's shows.
They can be exchanged for cash.
They admit only one person each.
questions.explanation: 공지문에서 무료 티켓은 '다음 시즌의 모든 공연'에 쓸 수 있다고 했고, 이메일에서 겨울 프로그램이 발표되는 1월 5일부터 예약 가능하다고 했으므로 겨울 시즌 공연에 유효함을 추론할 수 있습니다. 공지문과 이메일을 연계하는 문제입니다.
